html:
SMTO-UI-0031 — Your message is empty or too long to queue

GUID: 0cef9b26-42de-43ae-99bf-3667143b8936
Slug: ui-prompt-invalid
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • SMTO can only line up a message that has some text and is no longer than 24,000 characters. This one was empty or too long, so it wasn't added and your queue didn't change.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If you were editing a message in the Queued list, type the text you want in the box, then select Save. To keep the message as it was, select Cancel edit. A queued message can't be saved blank, and Cancel edit leaves it unchanged.
  2. If your message is very long, cut it down or split it into two messages, each under 24,000 characters. SMTO won't queue a message over 24,000 characters, so shorter pieces can each be accepted.
  3. For a long document, attach it with Add context and keep your message to a short request. Attached files don't count toward the message length limit.

What success looks like

  • Your message is accepted and shows in the conversation or the Queued list, or your edited text shows there after you select Save.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, with the length of your message. Don't keep resending the same blank or overly long text; it will be refused each time.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Prompt-queue validation rejected the prompt because it is not a string, is blank after trimming, or is longer than 24,000 characters; nothing was sent to the task lane.

What this means

  • A queued prompt is not text, is blank after trimming, or exceeds 24000 characters. The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • A queued prompt is not text, is blank after trimming, or exceeds 24000 characters.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect type, trimmed content and total character count.

How to fix it

  • prompt_queue.js checkText() throws ui_prompt_invalid on enqueue and on Save in the queued-prompt editor when the text is non-string, whitespace-only or over 24,000 characters. Supply 1 to 24,000 characters of non-blank text; the server still applies its own admission checks after this.
  • Enter a nonempty prompt of at most 24000 characters before queueing.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • An ordinary task prompt of supported length passes queue validation.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
